items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I got a chance to hear some of his -- Frank Trombquer's and some of Bix Beider-becke's tunes

ctx.x: Did you know Frank Trombquer? Did you know any of the white musicians in St. Louis?
No. No, I don't know -- I got a chance to hear some of his -- Frank Trombquer's and some of Bix Beider-becke's tunes that they were doing -- things like that.
Uh-huh. They worked at the Arcadia Ballroom there.
